shots.focal_element: Centered white two-line headline, later a row of three line-icons with labels (Consolidate tools / Remain competitive / Drive innovation)
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the tilted integration-logo wall from the previous shot; the cut point itself (11.55 s) is before the first 2 fps sample, so its exact form is not visible
shots.typography: Bold geometric/humanist sans, sentence case, normal tracking; two-tier headline with a smaller lead-in line ('See inside' / 'across') above a much larger main line; icon labels in bold sans, two-line stacked, centered. Font guess (low confidence): a Datadog brand sans similar to Noto Sans / custom.
shots.what_happens: Headline 'See inside any source' over a perspective-tilted wall of integration logo tiles swaps its lead-in to 'across any tech stack' (w25-w34) as diagonal violet light bands wipe over and replace the logo wall with a blue-violet gradient. The text clears and a hub-and-spoke line icon with 'Consolidate tools' scales up centered (w41-w43); it then shrinks and slides left while a lightbulb-check icon with 'Drive innovation' enters and grows (w44-w45); finally both move to the sides and a shield-fist icon with 'Remain competitive' takes the large center slot (w46-w48). A black vignette encroaches from the right edge at the end, leading into the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: On a blue-to-violet gradient, swap the headline's lead-in word line on cue, sweep diagonal translucent violet bars across to cover the logo wall, then run a three-step icon carousel where each new white line icon + label scales into the center while the previous one shrinks (~40%) and slides to a side slot, timed to VO words 41, 44 and 47.

shots.focal_element: Rounded-square gradient app-icon tiles (stack/database icon first) appearing on pure black
shots.what_happens: On black, a single blue stacked-layers app tile appears at center, then more glowing gradient tiles (GitHub, Slack, Prometheus-style, Azure-style 'A', Nvidia, OpenAI, Salesforce, Amazon, Docker and others) pop in around it until a dense grid fills the frame, illustrating 'Pre-built integrations' (w49-w51).
shots.build_rebuild: On a black canvas, place a 4-5 column grid of 64px rounded-square gradient icon tiles with a soft outer glow and reveal them one by one outward from the center tile with a staggered scale-up pop (~60-80 ms stagger) over ~1.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Centered white headline over a dark purple starfield
shots.transition_other: Hyperspace zoom: the icon grid rushes past the camera with radial motion-blur streaks into a starfield
shots.typography: Medium-weight sans, sentence case, normal tracking; 'Manage trillions of data points' first set large, then shrinks to a small lead-in line as the larger bold 'with one platform' appears beneath it; white on dark.
shots.what_happens: The icon grid from the previous shot holds briefly, then the camera flies through it with radial speed streaks (light-speed effect) into a dark violet starfield. 'Manage trillions of data points' appears centered (w55-w59), then shrinks and moves up as a bigger 'with one platform' line lands below (w63-w65); stars twinkle subtly.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the icon grid up past the camera with a radial zoom-blur streak overlay for ~0.4 s, cut to a slowly drifting particle starfield, fade in a centered headline, then on VO word 63 scale it to ~45% while sliding it up and fade/scale in a larger second line below.

shots.focal_element: Bold violet two-line headline overlaid on the Datadog Marketplace app grid
shots.transition_other: Not visible in the 2 fps samples (the starfield-to-UI change happens before the first sample at 26.5 s)
on_screen_text: Extend your monitoring reach with the Datadog Marketplace
shots.typography: Heavy bold sans, sentence case, slightly tight tracking, saturated violet fill set directly on the light UI without a plate; words appear in VO-synced groups ('with' and 'the' spaced apart before 'Datadog Marketplace' fills in). UI labels in small regular sans (not transcribed).
shots.what_happens: A real Datadog Marketplace screen (tabs: Integrations, Marketplace, Developer Platform; category chips; 'All Apps' grid of partner cards like Box, Oracle Solaris, CircleCI, Zoom, NetApp, Workday) is shown slightly perspective-tilted and slowly drifting/pushing in; a few cards briefly highlight with outlines early on. The headline 'Extend your monitoring reach' appears at w69-w72, then 'with the' and 'Datadog Marketplace' complete the second line word-by-word; the UI under the text fades slightly for legibility. Anchors report 1 motion event in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a marketplace screenshot with a slight 3D tilt (rotateY ~-5deg, rotateX ~3deg) and a slow 1.0-to-1.05 scale push over 7 s, briefly outline-highlight 3-4 cards at the start, then reveal a bold violet two-line headline word-by-word synced to VO words 69-72 and the rest of the line ~1.5 s later, dimming the UI to ~70% under the text.

shots.focal_element: Oversized recreated search field with the query 'Kubernetes' being typed
shots.typography: Headline in bold white sans, sentence case, normal tracking, left-aligned above the field; query text in regular dark sans with a typing caret.
shots.what_happens: On a soft blue-violet gradient with a light bloom top-right, a large white search bar (magnifier icon) bleeds off the right edge under the headline 'Find what you need faster' (w83-w87); 'Kubernetes' types in with a blinking caret, then the composition starts sliding left at the end (a faint 'AWS' chip begins to appear bottom-right), leading into the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a blurred blue-violet gradient, left-align a bold white headline above an oversized white rounded search input that runs off the right edge, type 'Kubernetes' at ~12 chars/s with a blinking caret, then start a leftward pan to reveal filter chips.
